summary: This tutorial introduces LibreOffice Impress, a free and open-source presentation software. It covers how to install and launch Impress on GNU/Linux using LibreOffice Suite. Key features include various toolbars such as Title bars, Menu bars, Formatting bars, and Status bars. The tutorial demonstrates creating a new presentation by selecting templates and customizing slides with backgrounds, borders, and text. It explains saving presentations in the ODP format and converting them to Microsoft PowerPoint for compatibility. Steps include creating a sample presentation, adding content, and exporting it as an ODP file. The tutorial also shows how to open and save Impress presentations, and how to convert them to PowerPoint format for use in MS Office environments.
